Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation

v1.2.0Foundry 14.370D&D5e 6.1.0+

All-in-one combat automation for Foundry VTT

Built on Foundry’s native D&D5e system and official Wizards of the Coast books for Foundry, Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation handles routine combat steps and gives players and GMs time to make the decisions they would at the table.

From one attack or spell, the module checks the current result, range, spell slots, feature uses, and available actions or Reactions. It offers choices such as Warding Flare, Deflect Attacks, and Shield when they can change the outcome. Once those choices are resolved or declined, the action advances and applies supported damage, healing, or effects according to the GM’s settings.

We’ve tested and refined these features together to reduce overlapping automation and repeated chat updates. Targets, rolls, and results stay connected on compact cards, so the table spends less time recalculating totals, undoing damage, or switching between controls.

Browse featuresWhat’s new in 1.2.0

Simple Combat Cards

A typical strike’s weapon use, attack, and damage fit on one card. It shows the target and results together, cuts repeated details, and grows as reactions and rolls resolve.

Compare the three-card and grouped layouts

Healing and temporary HP use the same grouped approach. Choose your attack, save and healing layouts in Module Options. Select any screenshot to view it at full size.

Main Features

Chat Cards and Corrections

  • Group item use, targets, attack or save results, damage, and effects with the action that produced them.
  • Adjust supported rolls with the original dice. Use Apply and Undo directly from the card.

Combat cards and GM controls

Smart Reactions and Combat Tracking

  • Pause automation when an eligible feature can change the outcome. The combat chat log shows the available choices as icons on the action’s card.
  • Click an icon to use the feature from your character sheet. The module uses the linked target or prompts you to choose one when needed, then spends the correct resource when you commit.
  • Players can use or decline their options. The GM can advance the decision or take over a pending save.
  • Track Bonus Actions, Reactions, and spell-slot use in combat. Show Legendary Action reminders when eligible.

Smart Reactions · Combat usage

Class Features, Feats, and Spells

  • Offer supported class, subclass, feat, and weapon mastery choices from native activities, roll configuration, or chat.
  • Use the official items’ scaling and resource pools.

Class Features · Spells, Monsters & Effects

Regions, Auras, and Targeting

  • Preview area targets and use activity rules to include allies, enemies, or all eligible creatures.
  • Trigger saves, damage, and conditions on entry, movement, or turn timing. Attached auras move with their source.

Region Automation · Targeting Assist

Repeat Effects and Monster Abilities

  • At the start or end of the affected creature’s turn, the module uses the original spell or ability to prompt the player or GM for the appropriate save or escape action.
  • For example, Hold Monster automatically prompts a repeat save at the end of the target’s turn. The follow-up uses the original save DC and source.
  • The module handles the outcome based on the effect’s rules. It can clear the effect, resolve recurring damage, or keep the effect active for another turn.

Monster Abilities · Repeat Effects

Character and Sheet Tools

  • Guide level-one character creation using the world’s enabled compendiums.
  • Add multiple spells from class-filtered results or load missing unprepared class spells on eligible sheets.

Create Player · Spell Lists

Module Options and Automation Libraries

  • Enable individual features and configure when reaction prompts pause combat.
  • Edit, disable, or restore the built-in Region and creature-effect recipes. Add recipes for supported native activities.

Module Options

Requirements and Installation

Official Foundry content

The module uses supported items, activities, and effects from official Wizards of the Coast Foundry releases, including the Player’s Handbook and Monster Manual. Install the books separately for the features you use.

Version 1.2.0

For Foundry VTT 14, verified with 14.370, and D&D5e 6.1.0 or later (verified on 6.1.0). The class updates target Player’s Handbook (2024) 3.0.0. Install and enable Automated Conditions 5e and Dice So Nice! alongside the module. Keep an active GM connected for shared resource, effect, and HP operations.

Updating existing characters? Updating the PHB does not replace features already on a character. Review older owned features before using the updated automation.

Install through the manifest

In Foundry’s Setup screen, open Add-on Modules → Install Module and use the installation manifest. Enable the module and its dependencies in your world, then refresh all GM and player clients.

Compatibility with other modules

These features use native D&D5e cards. Other automation packages, including Midi-QOL, or item macros that replace the same workflow can conflict. D&D Beyond imports are not verified and may need their activities or effects configured to match the documented sources. The detailed guides explain supported features and table-managed steps.
